highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform compatibility, native reliability, and managed image and text-processing performance.
highlights_body: The upcoming release adopts Uno Platform 7, raises Apple deployment minimums, refreshes the bundled renderer, and corrects native data handling.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer with the latest Chrome m156 bug fixes.
FromCString now avoids reading past its native input buffer and writes directly into SKData.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily
bullets.detail: Releases retained stream data once it is no longer needed.

bullets.lead: Managed pixel and text processing optimized
bullets.detail: Reduces allocation and copying overhead for image pixels, HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding, and native feature strings.

bullets.lead: Apple and Android platform support updated
bullets.detail: Raises Apple deployment minimums and synchronizes Android texture rendering with display refresh.
Aligns Windows dependencies with current MAUI releases, modernizes ANGLE, and includes WebGPU support in the native library.
Resolves bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Uno Platform 7 support and native WebGPU packaging
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Bundled HarfBuzz binding support on Linux and Blazor sample test stabilization
